vulnerable_statements.reason: This releases device_mode (its DMA buffers and the struct itself via kfree) before the mode-specific free callback runs, so device_mode is a dangling pointer from here on.
The per-mode free callback receives device_mode after free_device_compression_mode() has already freed it, so the callback reads freed memory (use-after-free).

suggested_fix: Call the mode-specific free callback (iaa_compression_modes[i]->free(device_mode)) before free_device_compression_mode(), so the callback runs while device_mode is still valid. Then free the device mode and set iaa_device->compression_modes[i] to NULL.
